title: Relapse Prevention and Changing Habits in Anorexia Nervosa 2.0
official: Making the MOST of Relapse Prevention in Anorexia Nervosa: A Treatment Optimization Study Targeting Habits
summary: This study aims to optimize a treatment package for the relapse prevention treatment of AN. In the current Optimization Phase, we will identify which components of treatment contribute to positive outcomes after structured treatment. We will carefully evaluate maintenance of remission, measured by rate of weight loss and end-of-trial status.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* DSM-5 diagnosis of Anorexia Nervosa or Atypical Anorexia Nervosa
* Completed acute treatment, including achieving weight-restoration
* Has a medical treatment provider (e.g. primary care doctor) who can be made aware that the patient is participating in the study
* Medically stable
* Access to internet-connected device with videoconferencing capability
* Will reside (after acute treatment discharge) in a state where a study therapist is licensed
* Not seeking or engaging in additional psychotherapy outside of the study (support groups are allowed)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current substance use disorder or other co-occurring psychiatric diagnoses that requires specialized treatment
* Pregnant
* High risk of suicide
* Current serious medical illness
* Daily medications that impact weight
